info.title: Brackenridge Finance collections tools
info.description: Mock of Brackenridge Finance's collections systems. Every call is written to the ledger the scorer reads. The service does not enforce the brief: it accepts a promise on a holiday, past a deadline or below a floor. Money read from get_account is in pounds with pence; money sent to create_promise is in integer pence.

post.summary: Check one security answer. The service counts wrong answers per call.

customer_ref.description: The call's customer reference, from the call variables. Pass it to every tool.

response.description: birth_date: eight digits DDMMYYYY, no separators (7 March 1984 is 07031984). home_postcode: capital letters and digits, no spaces. A value in the wrong format is rejected with ok=false and is not counted as a wrong answer.

200.description: `ok` is false when the action was not carried out; `error` then says why.

attempts_remaining.description: Wrong answers still allowed before the check fails.

identity_passed.description: true once both questions are answered correctly

500.description: The service failed. For create_promise the promise may or may not have reached the ledger; the brief says what to do. For other tools nothing was recorded.
